title: Capital Plan Schedule — Balance Kept on a Class H Preferred Stock Holding after Redemption, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The redemption minimum of a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding rests on the size of the holding at the start of the current quarter (1 July 2026 to 30 September 2026).

## Schedule

| Shares carried at the start of the quarter | Redemption minimum (balance kept) |
|---|---|
| 50000 or more | The larger of the class's smallest balance after a partial redemption and 15 percent of those start-of-quarter shares |
| 20000 or more but below 50000 | The larger of the class's smallest balance after a partial redemption and 10 percent of them |
| Below 20000 | The class's smallest balance after a partial redemption |

The class's smallest balance after a partial redemption is USD 1000 for Class H Preferred Stock (capital plan schedule).

**Start-of-quarter shares** are measured as the holding's present shares (its purchases plus its reinvested dividends less its retirements) less its latest reinvested dividend and latest purchase when dated inside the quarter, plus its latest retirement when dated inside the quarter. "Inside the quarter" means dated on or after 1 July 2026 and on or before 30 September 2026; the latest entry of a kind is the one with the latest effective date on the holding.

## Worked lines (hypothetical holdings)

| Start-of-quarter shares | Computation | Redemption minimum |
|---|---|---|
| 80,000.00 | Larger of 1,000.00 and 15 percent (12,000.00) | 12,000.00 |
| 50,000.00 | Larger of 1,000.00 and 15 percent (7,500.00) | 7,500.00 |
| 49,999.99 | Larger of 1,000.00 and 10 percent (4,999.999) | 4,999.999 |
| 20,000.00 | Larger of 1,000.00 and 10 percent (2,000.00) | 2,000.00 |
| 19,999.99 | Below 20000 | 1,000.00 |

A holding with present shares of 52,000.00 whose latest purchase, of 3,000.00, is dated 10 July 2026, and whose latest reinvested dividend and latest retirement are dated before 1 July 2026, carried 49,000.00 at the start of the quarter; its redemption minimum is 10 percent of 49,000.00, that is 4,900.00.
